claim: A self-driving car is capable of operating with reduced or no human input.
quote: A self-driving car...is a car that is capable of operating with reduced or no human input.

claim: The term 'self-driving' lacks an agreed standard definition as of 2026.
quote: As of 2026, the term 'self-driving' lacks an agreed standard definition.

claim: Self-driving cars are sometimes called robotaxis when operated for ridesharing.
quote: They are sometimes called robotaxis, though this term refers specifically to self-driving cars operated for a ridesharing company.

claim: LiDAR and visual sensors are primary technologies used in self-driving cars.
quote: two main technologies are now primarily used: LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging), and visual sensors (cameras)

claim: The SAE International defines levels of automation from 0 to 5.
quote: on a scale of 0 to 5 levels of automation defined by the global standards organization SAE International

claim: Public acceptance of autonomous cars is influenced by 'self-AV bias'.
quote: Public acceptance is also influenced by 'self-AV bias', where drivers judge identical autonomous vehicle driving much more harshly than human.

claim: Wayve Technologies Ltd is a British company focused on developing autonomous driving systems using end-to-end deep learning.
quote: Wayve Technologies Ltd is a British autonomous driving technology company focused on developing self-driving vehicle systems through end-to-end deep learning.

claim: Wayve's approach to autonomous driving eschews detailed 3D maps and hand-coded rules in favor of a self-learning AI driver.
quote: Wayve’s approach eschews detailed 3D maps and hand-coded rules, in favour of a self-learning "AI driver".

claim: Wayve's autonomous driving system primarily uses camera data and machine learning algorithms.
quote: Wayve’s platform learns to drive predominantly using camera data and machine learning algorithms.

claim: Wayve's AI-driven driving software is referred to as an "Embodied AI" or AI Driver.
quote: The company refers to its AI-driven driving software as an “Embodied AI” or AI Driver.

claim: Wayve's autonomy stack is hardware-agnostic and consists of video cameras and basic automotive sensors.
quote: The Wayve hardware-agnostic autonomy stack consists of a suite of video cameras, with basic automotive sensors.

claim: Wayve plans to license or embed its technology into vehicles made by established automakers rather than build its own cars.
quote: Wayve’s strategy is to provide its driving AI as an OEM-ready platform; it plans to license or embed its technology into vehicles made by established automakers.

claim: Mobile robotics is a subfield of robotics and information engineering.
quote: Mobile robotics is usually considered to be a subfield of robotics and information engineering.

claim: Autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) can navigate uncontrolled environments without guidance devices.
quote: Mobile robots can be "autonomous" (AMR - autonomous mobile robot) which means they are capable of navigating an uncontrolled environment without the need for physical or electro-mechanical guidance devices.

claim: Mobile robots are used in commercial, industrial, military, and security settings.
quote: Mobile robots are also found in industrial, military and security settings.

claim: Mobile robots are equipped with controllers, sensors, actuators, and power systems.
quote: The components of a mobile robot are a controller, sensors, actuators and power system.

claim: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) describes wireless communication between a vehicle and any entity that may affect, or may be affected by, the vehicle.
quote: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) describes wireless communication between a vehicle and any entity that may affect, or may be affected by, the vehicle.

claim: V2X is intended to improve road safety and traffic efficiency while reducing pollution and saving energy.
quote: it is a vehicular communication system that is intended to improve road safety and traffic efficiency while reducing pollution and saving energy.

claim: There are two standards for dedicated V2X communications: WLAN-based and cellular-based.
quote: There are two standards for dedicated V2X communications depending on the underlying wireless technology being used: (1) WLAN-based, and (2) cellular-based.

claim: Vehicle-to-device (V2D) involves Bluetooth or WiFi-Direct communication, such as Apple's CarPlay and Google's Android Auto.
quote: Vehicle-to-device (V2D) - Bluetooth / WiFi-Direct, e.g. Apple's CarPlay and Google's Android Auto.

claim: Vehicle-to-grid (V2G) involves information exchange with the smart grid to balance loads more efficiently.
quote: Vehicle-to-grid (V2G) - information exchange with the smart grid to balance loads more efficiently.

claim: Vehicle-to-network (V2N) involves communication between a vehicle and a wider network, such as a cellular network.
quote: Vehicle-to-network (V2N) - communication between a vehicle and a wider network, such as a cellular network.

claim: Vehicle-to-cloud (V2C) includes OTA updates and remote vehicle diagnostics.
quote: Vehicle-to-cloud (V2C) - e.g. OTA updates, remote vehicle diagnostics (DoIP).

claim: Vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) involves communication with traffic lights, lane markers, and parking meters.
quote: Vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) - e.g. traffic lights, lane markers and parking meters.

claim: Vehicle-to-pedestrian (V2P) communication is used for wheelchairs and bicycles, designating vulnerable road users (VRUs).
quote: Vehicle-to-pedestrian (V2P) - e.g. wheelchairs and bicycles, commonly also used to designate vulnerable road users (VRUs).

claim: Vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) involves real-time data exchange with nearby vehicles.
quote: Vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) - real-time data exchange with nearby vehicles.

claim: Lane departure warning systems (LDWS) are designed to warn drivers when a vehicle begins to move out of its lane.
quote: a lane departure warning system ( LDWS ) is a mechanism designed to warn the driver when the vehicle begins to move out of its lane.

claim: Lane departure warning systems aim to minimize accidents caused by driver error, distractions, and drowsiness.
quote: These systems are designed to minimize accidents by addressing the main causes of collisions: driver error, distractions and drowsiness.

claim: Lane departure warning systems can use video, laser, and infrared sensors to detect lane markings.
quote: Lane warning/keeping systems are based on: Video sensors... Laser sensors... Infrared sensors...

claim: Lane keeping assist systems can automatically take steps to keep a vehicle in its lane if the driver does not respond to warnings.
quote: Lane keeping assist (LKA/LKS): Systems which warn the driver and, with no response, automatically take steps to ensure the vehicle stays in its lane.

claim: Automated lane keeping systems (ALKS) are designed to follow lane markings without human intervention.
quote: Automated lane keeping systems (ALKS): Designed to follow lane markings with no human driver.

claim: Lane detection systems often use the Hough transform and Canny edge detector to identify lane lines from camera images.
quote: A lane detection system... uses the principle of Hough transform and Canny edge detector to detect lane lines from realtime camera images.

claim: Emergency lane keeping (ELK) systems apply corrections when a vehicle drifts beyond a solid lane marking.
quote: The emergency lane keeping applies correction to a vehicle which drifts beyond a solid lane marking.

claim: Lane departure warning systems do not function if lane edges are not marked by lines.
quote: This system does not work when the edge of the lane is not marked by a line.

claim: The first production lane departure warning system in Europe was developed by Iteris for Mercedes Actros trucks in 2000.
quote: The first production lane departure warning system in Europe was developed by the United States company Iteris for Mercedes Actros commercial trucks.

claim: Lane departure warning systems can issue warnings through visual, audible, and vibration alerts.
quote: Systems which warn the driver if the vehicle is leaving its lane with visual, audible, and/or vibration warnings.

claim: Cruise LLC focused on producing a fleet of driverless taxis as a subsidiary of General Motors.
quote: focusing on producing a fleet of driverless taxis.

claim: Cruise initially developed direct-to-consumer kits for retrofitting vehicles with limited self-driving capabilities.
quote: Cruise initially focused on developing direct-to-consumer kits to retrofit vehicles with limited self-driving capabilities.

claim: Cruise received a permit to test self-driving vehicle technology from the California DMV in June 2015.
quote: Cruise received a permit to test self-driving vehicle technology from the California Department of Motor Vehicles in June 2015.

claim: Cruise was acquired by General Motors in March 2016, forming the core of GM's self-driving efforts.
quote: Cruise was acquired by General Motors in March 2016. Cruise forms the core of GM's self-driving efforts.

claim: Cruise received a permit to provide driverless taxi rides in California in September 2021.
quote: In September 2021, Cruise received a permit from the California Department of Motor Vehicles to provide driverless taxi rides in the state.

claim: Cruise announced plans to expand its service to Phoenix, Arizona, and Austin, Texas, in September 2022.
quote: In September 2022, the company announced it would expand its service to Phoenix, Arizona , and Austin, Texas , within three months.

claim: Cruise's operations were suspended in October 2023 due to safety concerns and incidents.
quote: In October 2023, following a barrage of safety concerns and incidents...the California DMV suspended Cruise's self-driving car permits.

claim: Vehicular automation involves using technology to assist or replace the operator of a vehicle.
quote: Vehicular automation is using technology to assist or replace the operator of a vehicle such as a car, truck, aircraft, rocket, military vehicle, or boat.

claim: Assisted vehicles are semi-autonomous, while fully autonomous vehicles can travel without a human operator.
quote: Assisted vehicles are semi-autonomous , whereas vehicles that can travel without a human operator are autonomous.

claim: Autonomous vehicle software includes perception, localization, and planning modules.
quote: Autonomous vehicle software generally contains several different modules that work together to enable self-driving capabilities.

claim: The perception module processes data from sensors like cameras, LIDAR, RADAR, and SONAR.
quote: The perception module ingests and processes data from various sensors, such cameras , LIDAR , RADAR , and ultrasonic SONAR.

claim: The localization module uses 3D point cloud data, GPS, IMU, and mapping information for precise positioning.
quote: The localization module uses 3D point cloud data, GPS , IMU , and mapping information to determine the vehicle's precise position.

claim: The planning module computes actions such as velocity and steering angle outputs.
quote: The planning module takes inputs from both perception and localization to compute actions to take, such as velocity and steering angle outputs.

claim: Machine learning algorithms, particularly deep neural networks, support autonomous vehicle systems.
quote: These modules are typically supported by machine learning algorithms, particularly deep neural networks.

claim: Sensor fusion techniques combine data from multiple sensors to improve accuracy and reliability.
quote: Modern autonomous driving systems increasingly employ sensor fusion techniques that combine data from multiple sensors to improve accuracy and reliability.

claim: Navigation systems, including GPS, are essential for autonomous vehicles.
quote: Navigation systems are a necessary element in autonomous vehicles. The Global Positioning System (GPS) is used for navigation.

claim: Autonomous vehicles use maps for navigation, which can be updated through crowdsourcing.
quote: Some systems crowdsource their map updates, using the vehicles themselves to update the map to reflect changes.

claim: Traffic data from roadside monitoring systems can be used to route autonomous vehicles efficiently.
quote: Traffic data may be supplied by roadside monitoring systems and used to route vehicles to best use a limited road system.

claim: GNSS enhancement technologies like RTK and PPP enhance vehicle positioning accuracy for autonomous navigation.
quote: Modern GNSS enhancement technologies, such as real-time kinematic (RTK) and precise point positioning (PPP), enhance the accuracy of vehicle positioning.

claim: The Stanford Cart was the first experimental autonomous vehicle, developed in the late 1970s.
quote: The "Stanford Cart", created by Hans Moravec in the late 1970s, was the first experimental autonomous vehicle.

claim: ALVINN was an autonomous vehicle developed by Carnegie Mellon University in the late 1980s.
quote: Approximately 20 years later the Robotics Lab at Carnegie Mellon University developed ALVINN (Autonomous Land vehicle in a Neural Network).

claim: Automated vehicles in EU legislation refer specifically to road vehicles like cars, trucks, or buses.
quote: Automated vehicles in European Union legislation refer specifically to road vehicles (car, truck, or bus).

claim: The SAE classification of levels is based on the role of the driver and the vehicle's operational design domain.
quote: The SAE classification of levels is based on the role of the driver, rather than the vehicle's capabilities, although these are related in the form of a "driving mode".

claim: The perception system in autonomous vehicles must identify vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, and road conditions.
quote: The perception system is responsible for observing the environment. It must identify everything that could affect the trip, including other vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, their movements, road conditions.

claim: Nuro is a similar autonomous delivery vehicle, larger than Starship robots and drives on the road.
quote: Nuro , a similar autonomous delivery vehicle, though larger at the size of a tiny car, and driving on the road.

claim: Amazon Scout is a robot used to deliver Amazon packages, similar to Starship robots.
quote: Amazon Scout – Robot used to deliver Amazon packages

claim: Zipline is a company that delivers medical supplies by drone, differing from ground-based delivery robots.
quote: Zipline (drone delivery company) – Company that delivers medical supplies by drone

claim: IoT technology is used in commercial asset tracking and fleet management, which are adjacent to autonomous vehicle technology.
quote: Commercial asset tracking and fleet management represent the largest single application of IoT, accounting for 22% of the total market.

claim: IoT encompasses technologies like ubiquitous computing, sensors, embedded systems, and machine learning, which are related to autonomous vehicles.
quote: The field has evolved due to the convergence of multiple technologies, including ubiquitous computing, sensors, embedded systems, and machine learning.

claim: Advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) are technologies that assist drivers with the safe operation of a vehicle.
quote: Advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) are technologies that assist drivers with the safe operation of a vehicle.

claim: ADAS uses automated technology, such as sensors and cameras, to detect nearby obstacles or driver errors and respond accordingly.
quote: ADAS uses automated technology, such as sensors and cameras, to detect nearby obstacles or driver errors and respond accordingly.

claim: ADAS can enable various levels of autonomous driving.
quote: ADAS can enable various levels of autonomous driving.

claim: ADAS is proven to reduce road fatalities by minimizing human error.
quote: ADAS is proven to reduce road fatalities by minimizing human error.

claim: ADAS may provide adaptive cruise control, assist in avoiding collisions, alert drivers to possible obstacles, warn of lane departure, assist in lane centering, incorporate satellite navigation, provide traffic warnings, provide navigational assistance through smartphones, automate lighting, or provide other features.
quote: ADAS may provide adaptive cruise control, assist in avoiding collisions, alert drivers to possible obstacles, warn of lane departure, assist in lane centering, incorporate satellite navigation, provide traffic warnings, provide navigational assistance through smartphones, automate lighting, or provide other features.

claim: Forward collision prevention systems have the potential to reduce crashes by 29%.
quote: forward collision prevention systems have the potential to reduce crashes by 29%.

claim: Lane keeping assistance is shown to offer a reduction potential of 19%, while blind zone detection could decrease crash incidents by 9%.
quote: lane keeping assistance is shown to offer a reduction potential of 19%, while blind zone detection could decrease crash incidents by 9%.

claim: Approximately 33% of new vehicles sold in the United States, Europe, Japan, and China had ADAS in 2021.
quote: approximately 33% of new vehicles sold in the United States, Europe, Japan, and China had ADAS.

claim: 50% of all automobiles on the road by the year 2030 are predicted to be ADAS-enabled.
quote: 50% of all automobiles on the road by the year 2030 would be ADAS-enabled.

claim: Anduril Industries specializes in advanced autonomous systems for military applications.
quote: Anduril Industries, Inc. is an American military technology company specializing in the development of advanced autonomous systems.

claim: Anduril's products include unmanned aerial systems and counter-UAS technologies.
quote: Anduril's major products include unmanned aerial systems (UAS) and counter-UAS (CUAS).

claim: Anduril develops semi-portable autonomous surveillance systems and networked command and control software.
quote: semi-portable autonomous surveillance systems, and networked command and control software.

claim: Anduril's Arsenal Projects aim to manufacture advanced autonomous weapons systems rapidly.
quote: Anduril announced a series of Arsenal Projects, hyperscale manufacturing facilities designed to manufacture advanced autonomous weapons systems.

claim: Anduril's Lattice surveillance towers are used for border security and military applications.
quote: Lattice surveillance towers were informally tested on a Texas rancher's private land.

claim: Anduril's Ghost drone is used by the Royal Marines for frontline video surveillance.
quote: The Royal Marines had been testing Anduril's Ghost drone to provide video of targets for frontline use.
